verdict.rationale: Plausible offers a Stats API for querying its own data and an Events API for sending events in, plus CSV export/import, but there is no evidence of syncing or continuously exporting events to an external data warehouse, nor querying warehouse tables in-product. missing for 10: warehouse export/sync capability (e.g. BigQuery/Snowflake integration), continuous event streaming to external warehouse, in-product warehouse query support.
